proof_summary: Writing the rank as \(n+\lfloor e^{H_n}-1\rfloor\), the proof establishes \(1<e^{H_{n+1}}-e^{H_n}<2\) using \(e^x>1+x\), monotonic control of \(e^{H_n}/n\), and finitely many initial estimates, so each floor increment is 1 or 2 and each rank increment is 2 or 3. Telescoping gives \(\#3=\lfloor e^{H_{N+1}}-1\rfloor-N-1\) and the complementary formula for \(\#2\); then \(H_n-\log n\to\gamma\) yields the ratio limit \((e^\gamma-1)/(2-e^\gamma)\), and explicit harmonic/logarithm and exponential-series bounds \(16/9<e^\gamma<41/23\) place it strictly between 3.5 and 3.6.
